resourceProfile.assessment: Canonical English, all effective Danish runtime entries, repository checks, and Danish dictionary and technical terminology sources were available.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review generation and TypeScript checking passed after every correction batch.

linguisticCritique.summary: Three complete-scope passes resolved 54 Unicode, electrical-current, UI, and terminology findings.

competentHumanReview.summary: The Danish corrections were machine-reviewed and still require competent human review.

publicationAuthorization.summary: This cycle authorizes a locale-specific commit only, not publication or deployment.

findings.summary: Twenty-three concept strings displayed literal Unicode escape text instead of Ω, α, Δ, or °C, and two calculator labels remained untranslated.
evidence: The effective runtime displayed text such as \u03a9 and \u00b0C.
The affected strings included worked electrical formulas and TCR values.
findings.resolution: Restored visible symbols and preserved all formulas and numeric values; translated the two calculator labels.

findings.summary: Twenty-five entries confused electrical current with present-time wording or retained inconsistent UI and control-board terminology.
evidence: Current limit was translated as the presently applicable limit.
Several loading labels, reference-resistance labels, and multi-coil names were inconsistent.
findings.resolution: Corrected electrical-current meaning, ellipses, reference resistance, control-board wording, and calculator labels.

findings.summary: Four result and export labels remained in English.
evidence: Sweet spot, DNA 200 output, and two download labels were not localized.
findings.resolution: Replaced them with concise Danish UI labels.
